objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape, noticeably shorter than a trumpet.
Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell.
Functional_Components: Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with finger buttons.
Cup-shaped detachable mouthpiece inserted into leadpipe.
Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.
Material_and_Context: Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body of compact, handheld size.
Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts on each side.
Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top.
Functional_Components: Four strings run from a tailpiece over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll.
Top plate has two f-shaped sound holes.
Fingerboard is ebony black with a chin rest attached at the lower left.
Material_and_Context: Top plate is spruce; back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern.
Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden.
Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.

objects.taxonomy_description: Fleet equine mammal measuring 120-150 cm at withers with distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern. Stripes unique to each individual, extending across body, legs, and mane. Head elongated with large dark eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched with erect bristly mane. Body robust and muscular. Legs long and slender terminating in single dark hooves. Tail long with black tufted hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African equine with herd behavior. Stripes serve as camouflage and fly deterrent.
